summary: Phase 6 (n8n WhatsApp integration) tested end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests pass covering GET/PUT/GET-events/POST-test/GET-logs/POST-payment-reminders-dispatch, RBAC 403 for Sales & Accounting on all 4 endpoints (8 param cases), event auto-trigger on POST /api/quotations writes a quotation.created log entry (verified against logs). Config persistence verified via GET-after-PUT. Test endpoint returns ok=false + skipped=true when disabled. Logs are JSON-serializable (no ObjectId leak). Payment reminder dispatch returns {total, dispatched, n8n_enabled} and does not crash on 0 due invoices. Frontend: Super Admin sees 'Integration' sidebar menu; /integration page renders with data-testid=integration-page and all required testids present: n8n-webhook-url, n8n-enabled-switch (aria-checked toggling), n8n-save-btn, n8n-test-btn, wa-save-btn, dispatch-reminders-btn, refresh-logs-btn, n8n-logs-table, 7 event-toggle-* switches, 3 wa-template-* textareas. Saving config triggers Indonesian toast 'Konfigurasi n8n tersimpan'. Test event, dispatch reminders, refresh logs all work and populate the log table (4 rows observed). RBAC frontend: Sales user does NOT see 'Integration' in sidebar; direct nav to /integration renders a clean '403 — Forbidden' page (integration-page not mounted). Cleanup performed: webhook_url reset to empty and enabled=false at the end of both API and UI runs.

issues: React console warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key, Accounting' — the sidebar renders two menu items keyed 'Accounting' (visible as duplicated Accounting rows in nav). Pre-existing (iteration_12 noted it) and still present. Non-blocking but should be fixed by de-duping nav config or making keys unique.

action_items: Fix duplicate 'Accounting' entry in /app/frontend/src/config/nav.js (two menu entries with the same key/label produce React duplicate-key warning and visually duplicated sidebar row for Super Admin).
critical_code_review_comments: Phase 6 backend routes (get_n8n_settings, put_n8n_settings, n8n_test, n8n_logs, dispatch_payment_reminders) correctly enforce settings.manage; RBAC via require_permission consistently returns 403 for Sales/Accounting.
trigger_n8n writes a delivery log even when disabled (skipped=true) — good for observability. Log serialization strips ObjectId (_id -> string) as required.
server.py continues to grow beyond 3000 lines; Phase 6 helpers could live in a routers/integrations.py module for maintainability.
Frontend Integration page: enabled Switch uses aria-checked properly and testids are complete; no error states observed.
